story: That Boy Hi Hat is the alternative-rap artist managed by Cumulative Web Inc. The breakout track is Zooted Zone — about 307,439 lifetime Spotify plays as of 2026-09-14, far above current monthly listeners: evidence the track converted at playlist scale before. Single 'Diabolique' released 2026-07-03, produced by Hybrid, co-produced by Black, recorded at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington, Virginia. 'Flamerz' producer: Jeck Da General. Zooted Zone credits: produced by Kokurcho (BET Awards-nominated, RIAA-certified Gold and multi-platinum), mixed/mastered by Hybrid, recorded Hagerstown, MD, Feb 2023.
